title: polygala vulgaris var. comosa
intro: Polygala vulgaris var. comosa, commonly known as Running or Creeping Milkwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Polygalaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities that can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Polygala vulgaris var. comosa include its ability to act as a hepatoprotective agent, supporting liver health, and as a bronchodilator, alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
